T: Make it home to Coney before the dogs go cold.
D: A Coney Island gang fights its way home across New York after being framed for murder.
P: Serve the dogs when the gang finally sees the ocean at Coney Island.
S: the boardwalk at the end of the line
Cut potatoes with a crinkle cutter, rinse, blanch at 140C, fry at 185C until gold, salt and serve in paper cones with malt vinegar.
waiting at home by the beach
Soak clam strips in evaporated milk 10 minutes, dredge in half corn flour, half plain flour with salt, fry at 185C for 60 seconds. Tartare and lemon.
the cheapest hot dinner on the long ride home
Mashed potato and caramelised onion wrapped in pastry, baked at 200C until golden and crisp, eaten hot with deli mustard.
M: Chilli sauce: fine beef mince stirred into water so it stays loose, onion, chilli powder, cumin, paprika and tomato paste, simmered 45 minutes. Over griddled franks with mustard and raw onion.
the hero shop at the end of the line
Thinly sliced steak chopped on a hot griddle with onions, melted cheese folded through, stuffed into long hero rolls with lettuce, tomato and mayo.
W: Toffee apples: boil 400g sugar, 100ml water and a splash of vinegar to 150C, add red colouring, dip skewered apples, set on baking paper. Bought fairy floss alongside.
K: the soda fountain by the Coney Island station
Chocolate syrup and malted milk powder whisked into cold milk with a scoop of vanilla ice cream, blended until thick.

steps.text: Mix the flour (keeping a spoonful back for the cheese dip), yeast, sugar, salt and warm water, then knead until smooth.
Cover and rise until doubled.
Roll into ropes and cut into 24 bites. Bring the boiling water and bicarb to a simmer.
Boil the bites in batches for 20 seconds, then drain on baking paper.
Bake at 220C until deep golden, then brush with melted butter and coarse salt.
For the dip, melt butter, stir in the remaining flour, whisk in the milk and simmer. Off the heat, stir in the cheddar and serve with mustard.
Quarter the cobs lengthways on a secure board with a sturdy sharp knife (use whole cobs if easier). Melt the butter with the chilli flakes and smoked salt.
Brush the corn with the chilli butter.
Roast at 220C, turning once, until tender and charred at the edges. Finish with lime juice.
Dice the onion and keep a quarter aside for topping. Mince the garlic.
Fry the rest of the onion in the oil with the garlic, then add the mince and brown well.
Stir in the tomato paste, spices, tomatoes and water and simmer. Season with salt.
Bake the fries as directed on the packet.
Griddle the franks until piping hot and warm the buns. Fill with franks and chilli and finish with onion and mustard.

dishes.make_ahead: Make up to 3 days ahead, keep frozen

steps.text: Soften the ice cream just enough to scoop and sandwich between the cookies to make 4 sandwiches.
Freeze on a lined tray until firm.
Melt the chocolate gently and cool until just warm. Dip half of each sandwich.
Return to the freezer to set.
Fill 4 glasses with ice, add cherry syrup to each, top with cola and squeeze in a lime wedge. Stir once and taste before adding more syrup.
Slice the capsicums and onions.
Brown the sausages in a pan until cooked through.
Fry the capsicum and onion in the oil until soft. Split the rolls, fill with sausages and peppers and onions.
Split the rolls and toast lightly.
Fry the eggs in the butter, then season and tuck two into each roll.

dishes.make_ahead: Make up to 2 days ahead, keep frozen

steps.text: Dissolve the sugar in the water over low heat, then cool.
Juice the lemons and stir into the syrup.
Freeze in a shallow tray, scraping with a fork every hour, until a fine shaved ice forms.
Scoop into paper cups to serve.
Pour a little syrup and milk into each of 4 tall glasses, top with seltzer and stir hard until it foams.
Brew a pot of coffee.
Serve with milk and sugar.

edition.cue: Bring out the chilli dogs when the journey heads back towards Coney Island.

s.note: Warm soft pretzel bites brushed with butter and coarse salt, with a hot cheddar sauce and yellow mustard for dipping.
s.how: Mix 250g plain flour, 4g instant yeast, 1 tsp sugar, 1/2 tsp salt and 160ml warm water. Knead 8 minutes, cover and rise 1 hour. Roll into ropes and cut into 24 bites. Simmer 1 litre water with 30g bicarbonate of soda; boil bites in batches for 20 seconds, drain and bake on baking paper at 220°C for 12 to 15 minutes. Brush with 20g melted butter. For dip, melt 15g butter, stir in 15g flour, whisk in 150ml milk and simmer 2 minutes. Remove from heat and stir in 100g grated cheddar. Serve with mustard.

s.note: Corn ribs roasted until charred and curling, brushed with chilli butter and smoked salt, finished with plenty of lime.
s.how: Quarter 4 corn cobs lengthways on a secure board with a sturdy sharp knife; use whole cobs if easier. Brush with 30g melted butter mixed with 1/2 tsp chilli flakes and a pinch of smoked salt. Roast at 220°C for 20 to 25 minutes, turning once, until tender and charred at the edges. Finish with the juice of 1 lime.

m.note: Griddled beef franks, rich beef chilli, diced onion and mustard. Shoestring fries on the side.
m.how: Dice 1 onion; reserve a quarter for topping. Fry the rest in 1 tbsp oil with 2 minced garlic cloves, add 400g beef mince and brown well. Stir in 1 tbsp tomato paste, 1 tsp each ground cumin and smoked paprika, 400g tinned tomatoes and 100ml water. Simmer 25 minutes; season with salt. Bake 600g shoestring fries as directed on the packet. Griddle 8 beef franks until piping hot and warm 8 buns. Fill buns with franks and chilli; finish with reserved onion and mustard. Serve fries alongside.

w.note: Vanilla ice cream, chewy chocolate cookies and dark chocolate.
w.how: Soften 500ml vanilla ice cream just enough to scoop. Sandwich between 8 large chewy chocolate cookies to make 4 sandwiches. Freeze on a lined tray for 1 hour. Melt 150g dark chocolate gently, cool until just warm, dip half of each sandwich and return to the freezer for 15 minutes. Make ahead so they're ready when the film finishes.

d.note: Ice-cold cola, cherry syrup and a squeeze of lime.
d.how: Fill 4 glasses with ice. Add 15ml cherry syrup to each, top each with 250ml cola and squeeze in a lime wedge. Stir once. Taste before adding more syrup.
